title: JEPA-WM on stable-worldmodel via adapter: same-platform, same-task, same-CEM head-to-head vs LeWM
verdict: K4_CONTROL_VALID_BUT_JEPA_SUCCESS_SIG_LOWER_THAN_LEWM; ROOT_CAUSE=WEAK_ACTION_CONDITION (model property, inference-period tuning proven ineffective)

predecessor.relation: LeWM lite line closed at 0.36 (CI [0.24,0.50]); this experiment adds JEPA-WM on the SAME platform to remove the harness confound

rationale: Discipline gate: a LeWM-vs-JEPA-WM claim requires both on the same stable-worldmodel platform, same tasks, same CEM budget. Current LeWM (0.36) and JEPA-WM (0.4583 on jepa-wms harness) are not comparable as-is.

feasibility_probe.world_model_attaches_to: CEMSolver(model=...), not World; same World.evaluate drives both
feasibility_probe.model_interface: get_cost(info_dict, candidates); candidates shape (B,N,H,D) in env action space; returns (B,N) latent-MSE cost
feasibility_probe.in_platform_prejepa_reason: wm/prejepa ships architecture only; no PushT weights; training out of current phase
feasibility_probe.external_jepa_wm_evidence: external/jepa-wms vendored; checkpoints/jepa_wm_pusht.pth.tar (211MB) local; EncPredWM.unroll + representation-target objective in repo
feasibility_probe.encoder: DINOv2 ViT-S/14 from HF (external to checkpoint; primary kill risk K3)

planned_config.task_source: same 0004 dataset-defined pairs (public parquet shard, same episode, 25 steps apart)

K1_adapter_buildable.detail: instantiate JEPAWMAdapter from local ckpt + vendored code; enc 22.06M/total 39.68M/dim 10

K2_finite_indistribution_predictions.detail: get_cost finite, no NaN/Inf/collapse; CAVEAT: cost landscape near-flat w.r.t. actions (toward-vs-away diff <0.1%), K2 weak threshold masked this

K3_encoder_offline_loadable.detail: DINOv2 ViT-S loads on cuda:0, no network

K4_same_protocol_closed_loop.detail: out_of_play_rate=0.10 (=threshold 0.1, 5/50 tasks flew out); control valid (block interaction 0.80, disp median 27.27 ~ LeWM 31.54); BUT success 0.02 (1/50) vs LeWM 0.36, Wilson CIs non-overlapping

result_summary.head_to_head: same platform / same 50 tasks / same CEM 10x100x10; success CIs non-overlapping -> JEPA-WM significantly lower task-success than LeWM; agent gross control comparable (block displacement median 27.27 vs 31.54)
result_summary.task_source_note: shard selected_pairs mutated 50->8 post-0004; K4 used --pairs-from KW-LEWM-0004 result to reuse its exact 50 tasks (true head-to-head)

root_cause_deep_dive.design: latent mobility (max_mob/gap_req) AND action leverage (do_nothing_disp vs max_mob) on 5 task pairs, H=5 latent steps, action scales [0,0.5,1,2,3] x N=30 random candidates
root_cause_deep_dive.verdict: ACTION_INSENSITIVE_PREDICTION (weak action conditioning; model property, NOT fixable at inference without retraining)
root_cause_deep_dive.interpretation: max latent mobility is ~3x the required gap (mobility is NOT the bottleneck); but do-nothing displacement equals max-action displacement (context_domination_ratio~1) and action_leverage~0 (actions buy no extra latent travel). Final-frame prediction is dominated by start context (visual+proprio); the action sequence has ~0 leverage on where the prediction lands.
root_cause_deep_dive.reconciles: 7.3 toward_better_than_away=false (all actions -> same cost) and 7.4.1 low success + comparable gross control (CEM has no gradient to precise goal, but coarse pushing works)

closed_loop_corroboration.verdict: CONFIRMS §8 from real closed-loop data (independent of latent diagnostic): displacement does not track goal distance (negatively correlated), success ~uncorrelated with geometry, large displacement does not yield success, OOP is drift not harder-goal

paired_behavioural_corroboration.verdict: THIRD independent evidence line for §8: same displacement budget, opposite progress sign. JEPA-WM's planner is statistically indistinguishable from no-op on task success and significantly worse than no-op on the block sub-criterion.
paired_behavioural_corroboration.also_strengthens_0004: no-op is 0/50 under the true 4-dim criterion; LeWM significantly beats it (McNemar p=7.6e-6), so 0004's 0.36 is genuine goal-directed control
paired_behavioural_corroboration.criterion_correction_recorded: Push-T success uses ||goal[:4]-cur[:4]||<20 (agent AND block share one 20px budget); the block-only variant reproduced only 81% of logged successes and was VOIDed by pre-declared gate R0

residual_approximations: scaler fitted on partial shard (80,384 rows), not official full training set
pixels re-rendered locally, not dataset-recorded pixels
allowed_claim_template: Under a disclosed lite protocol, both LeWM and JEPA-WM run on the same stable-worldmodel platform, same 50 dataset tasks, same CEM 10x100x10: success X (LeWM) vs Y (JEPA-WM), 95% CI [..,..] each.
forbidden_claims: either model 'better' unless CIs do not overlap AND all residual approximations disclosed
using either number as an official number
